question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a green ball, Bob has a brown ball, Claire has a purple ball, Dave has a pink ball, Eve has a white ball, Fred has a red ball, and Gertrude has a orange ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Eve and Dave swap balls. Then, Claire and Eve swap balls. Then, Dave and Claire swap balls. Then, Bob and Fred swap balls. Then, Fred and Dave swap balls. Then, Eve and Alice swap balls. Finally, Dave and Gertrude swap balls. At the end of the game, Alice has the
Options:
(A) green ball
(B) brown ball
(C) purple ball
(D) pink ball
(E) white ball
(F) red ball
(G) orange ball

Let me start by listing out each person and the ball they have at the beginning.
Alice has green, Bob has brown, Claire has purple, Dave has pink, Eve has white, Fred has red, and Gertrude has orange.
Now, the swaps happen in a sequence, so I'll go through each one step by step to track where each ball moves.
First swap: Eve and Dave trade.
So Eve gives her white ball to Dave, and Dave gives his pink ball to Eve.
Now, Eve has pink, Dave has white.
Next, Claire and Eve swap.
Claire has purple, and Eve now has pink.
So after swapping, Claire gets pink and Eve gets purple.
Then, Dave and Claire swap.
Dave has white, Claire has pink.
So after swapping, Dave gets pink and Claire gets white.
Now, Bob and Fred swap.
Bob has brown, Fred has red.
After swapping, Bob gets red and Fred gets brown.
Next, Fred and Dave swap.
Fred has red, Dave has pink.
So after swapping, Fred gets pink and Dave gets red.
Then, Eve and Alice swap.
Eve has purple, Alice has green.
So after swapping, Eve gets green and Alice gets purple.
Finally, Dave and Gertrude swap.
Dave has red, Gertrude has orange.
So after swapping, Dave gets orange and Gertrude gets red.
Wait, let me make sure I didn't mix up any steps.
Let me go through each swap again to confirm.
Eve ↔ Dave: Eve gets pink, Dave gets white.
Claire ↔ Eve: Claire gets pink, Eve gets purple.
Dave ↔ Claire: Dave gets pink, Claire gets white.
Bob ↔ Fred: Bob gets red, Fred gets brown.
Fred ↔ Dave: Fred gets pink, Dave gets red.
Eve ↔ Alice: Eve gets green, Alice gets purple.
Dave ↔ Gertrude: Dave gets orange, Gertrude gets red.
So after all swaps, Alice has the purple ball.
Looking at the options, that's option C.
